session: extended_analyses_pass (RankSafe-Cal, transfer, conformal, robustness, mechanistic, subgroup, integrity)
title: When Better Rankings Mean Worse Probabilities: A Calibration Audit of ECG Foundation Models

new_analyses.name: Extended calibration metrics (NLL, adaptive ECE, classwise ECE, cal slope/intercept)
RankSafe-Cal (rank-preserving recalibration, OOS AUROC-loss certified)
new_analyses.key_finding: PTB-XL ECE 0.097->0.054 at +0.0018 AUROC loss (isotonic 0.046 at +0.0108); on MIMIC beats isotonic on both axes

new_analyses.name: Cross-dataset calibration transfer
new_analyses.key_finding: Transfer succeeds in only 9-42% of endpoint/model pairs (NORM 9%, AF 28%, RBBB 41%, MI 42%); calibration is largely deployment-context-specific

new_analyses.name: Split-conformal prediction (one-vs-rest MI/AF/NORM)
new_analyses.key_finding: 90% target coverage met by all methods; Platt most set-efficient; temperature == raw (order-preserving)

new_analyses.name: Expanded decision-curve analysis (MI on PTB-XL/MIMIC; AF on CODE/CPSC/MIMIC)
new_analyses.key_finding: All models positive integrated net benefit above treat-all (MI ~+0.027; AF ~+0.19 on CODE-15%)

new_analyses.name: Multi-seed robustness (10 resplits, PTB-XL & MIMIC)
new_analyses.key_finding: PTB-XL S4D best-ECE in 10/10 seeds (robust); ECG-FM below MERL/ST-MEM all seeds but tied with S4D (below S4D only 2/10) -> claim softened

new_analyses.name: Mechanistic regression of ECE
new_analyses.key_finding: OLS n=149 R2=0.85; dataset/task dominates (PTB-XL ref; CODE -0.074, CPSC -0.076), masked-pretraining +0.044, supervised -0.018

new_analyses.name: Subgroup calibration across all 6 encoders (PTB-XL age/sex)
new_analyses.key_finding: Age gradient: ECE rises <55 -> >=70 for every FM (e.g. ST-MEM 0.111->0.189) but flat for S4D (0.117->0.114)

new_analyses.name: Integrity / leakage audit
new_analyses.key_finding: No patient leakage in any cell; all checkpoints loadable; LBBB@MIMIC excluded (9 test pos); dataset completeness verified

new_analyses.name: Canonical probability caches (substrate for all extended analyses)
